messages.text: Hey, I'm Sarah! At about sixteen cents the Magic Miner 40T costs around $75 a month to run. It's $799, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Garage or out of the way
Looked up for Sarah: Garage is ideal — 40T runs ~50 dB in Eco, tunable 30 TH at 450 W, 40 TH at 650 W, 50 TH at 850 W. $799, Batch 6, ships Nov 21.
A garage is perfect for a 650 watt unit. At sixteen cents it's about two fifty a day in power. Is this your first miner?
Looked up for Sarah: First-time buyer: 40T is plug-and-play, Wi-Fi or ethernet, solo to their own address — but it's pre-sale, shipping November 21.
Then this is a great first one. You run a real piece of the Bitcoin network from your garage, and you learn pools and wallets on hardware you own. Which matters more to you?
Looked up for Sarah: For steady sats, point the 40T at a pool — payouts straight to their own wallet, no exchange, no KYC. Power runs about $75 a month at 16¢.
Then point it at a pool. It pays small, steady sats straight into your own wallet, with no exchange involved. Power runs about seventy-five a month at your rate. Want to grab one?
Looked up for Sarah: Best value per TH we sell: $16 a terahash, $799 for up to 50 TH in Turbo. Shipping is $40 flat worldwide; Batch 6 ships November 21.

You can tune it. At thirty terahash it draws 450 watts, which is about fifty-two a month at your rate, or run the full forty. It ships November 21. Which setting would you go with? (The call ended. 4 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
